description: This file defines internal error classes, error codes, and related utility functions for Node.js core, including error creation, stack trace handling, and specific error types like SystemError. It also registers numerous Node.js-specific error codes with detailed messages.

classes.name: SystemError
classes.description: A specialized Error class that includes additional info properties such as code, errno, syscall, path, and dest, used for representing system-related errors in Node.js.

methods.name: makeSystemErrorWithCode
methods.description: Creates a custom SystemError class associated with a specific error code.

methods.name: makeNodeErrorWithCode
methods.description: Creates a custom Error class extending a base class, associated with a specific error code.

methods.name: addCodeToName
methods.description: Adds error code to the error's name property and captures the stack trace.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves and formats error messages based on error code keys and arguments.

methods.name: hideStackFrames
methods.description: Wraps a function to hide its stack frames from error stacks.

methods.name: uvErrmapGet
methods.description: Retrieves the error message associated with a libuv error code.

methods.name: uvException
methods.description: Creates an Error object representing a libuv error with context information.

methods.name: uvExceptionWithHostPort
methods.description: Creates an Error object for libuv errors involving host and port information.

methods.name: errnoException
methods.description: Creates an Error object for system errors based on errno.

methods.name: exceptionWithHostPort
methods.description: Creates an Error object for libuv errors with host and port details (deprecated, replaced by uvExceptionWithHostPort).

methods.name: dnsException
methods.description: Creates an Error object for DNS-related errors, translating error codes.

methods.name: isStackOverflowError
methods.description: Detects if an error is a stack overflow error based on engine-specific message and name.
